project: JARVIS TRADER — Agent 5: Learning System Wiring
description: The learning system has 4 modules (events, feedback, patterns, recommendations) that are built but disconnected from the live pipeline. Wire recommendations into Stage 1 (TechnicalAnalyst context) so that historical trade patterns improve future analysis. Add GET /learning/status endpoint. Connect feedback and patterns triggers to closed trade events.

userStories.title: Map the full learning system — what's connected vs disconnected
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a precise map of which learning modules are wired and which are not before making any changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Read engine/learning/events.py — document what triggers it, what it produces
Read engine/learning/feedback.py — document inputs, outputs, connection status
Read engine/learning/patterns.py — document inputs, outputs, connection status
Read engine/learning/recommendations.py — document inputs, outputs, connection status
Read engine/agents/pipeline.py Stage 1 — identify TechnicalAnalyst context construction
Document in progress.txt: exact connection points missing, exact functions to call
No code changes — analysis only
userStories.notes: The previous session analysis says 'learning loop built but disconnected'. Confirm exactly which wires are missing.

userStories.title: Wire trade-close event to feedback module
userStories.description: As the learning system, I want to automatically generate a lesson when a paper trade closes so that the feedback module builds up trading knowledge over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify where trades are closed in engine (likely engine/routers/ or engine/execution/)
After trade close, call learning.feedback.process_trade_outcome(trade_result)
feedback.process_trade_outcome generates a lesson and persists it
Wiring is async and non-blocking — trade close should not wait for learning
Add logging: 'Learning: feedback generated for trade {trade_id}'
Unit test: mock a trade close and verify feedback.process_trade_outcome is called
Commit: feat: wire trade-close event to learning feedback module
userStories.notes: Use asyncio.create_task() for non-blocking wiring pattern — match existing async patterns in codebase

userStories.title: Wire feedback output to patterns module
userStories.description: As the learning system, I want patterns to be updated whenever new feedback is generated so the pattern library stays current.
acceptanceCriteria: After feedback.process_trade_outcome completes, call learning.patterns.update_patterns(feedback_result)
patterns.update_patterns aggregates lessons into recurring patterns
Patterns are persisted to disk/DB
Add logging: 'Learning: patterns updated ({n} patterns in library)'
Unit test: verify patterns.update_patterns is called after feedback generation
Commit: feat: wire feedback to patterns module — automatic pattern library updates

userStories.title: Wire recommendations into Stage 1 TechnicalAnalyst context
userStories.description: As the TechnicalAnalyst, I want to receive relevant historical pattern recommendations as part of my analysis context so that past lessons inform future signals.
acceptanceCriteria: Before Stage 1 TechnicalAnalyst prompt construction, call learning.recommendations.get_recommendations(symbol, timeframe)
Recommendations are injected into the TechnicalAnalyst system prompt or context as: 'Historical pattern context: [recommendations]'
If recommendations are empty or module fails, Stage 1 proceeds normally with no error
Injection is logged: 'Learning: {n} recommendations injected for {symbol}'
Recommendations are filtered by relevance: only patterns for the current symbol and market regime
Unit test: verify recommendations are present in TechnicalAnalyst context when patterns exist
Commit: feat: inject learning recommendations into Stage 1 TechnicalAnalyst context
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: This must not break the pipeline if learning system fails. Wrap in try/except with graceful fallback.

userStories.title: Add GET /learning/status endpoint
userStories.description: As the dashboard, I want to query the learning system status to show how many patterns, lessons, and recommendations exist.
acceptanceCriteria: New endpoint: GET /learning/status

Response: {"feedback_lessons": int, "patterns": int, "recommendations_available": int, "last_lesson_at": str|null, "connection_status": {"events": bool, "feedback": bool, "patterns": bool, "recommendations": bool}}
Add to engine/routers/learning_router.py (create if not exists)
Register in main.py
Smoke test: curl http://localhost:8010/learning/status
Commit: feat: add GET /learning/status endpoint

userStories.title: Add learning status widget to dashboard
userStories.description: As a trader, I want to see the learning system status on the dashboard so I know it's accumulating knowledge.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a 'Learning System' status widget to the command center or a relevant dashboard page
Widget shows: lessons collected, patterns identified, recommendations active, last lesson timestamp
Fetches from GET /learning/status
Badge 'bull' when all modules connected, 'warn' when partially connected, 'bear' when disconnected
cd dashboard && pnpm run build — passes
Commit: feat: add learning system status widget to dashboard
userStories.notes: Coordinate with Agent 4 if they're modifying the command center page — read progress.txt for Agent 4 status

userStories.title: Run full test suite and verify learning loop E2E
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the complete learning loop tested end-to-end: trade close → feedback → patterns → recommendations → pipeline injection.
acceptanceCriteria: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest tests/ -v — 0 failures
If live engine is available: submit a paper trade, close it, verify GET /learning/status shows +1 lesson
If Anthropic credits available: run POST /pipeline/run and verify recommendations appear in stage 1 output
cd dashboard && pnpm run build — passes
Commit: test: learning system E2E loop verification
userStories.notes: E2E test with real pipeline requires Anthropic credits. If credits unavailable, unit tests are sufficient for this story.
